## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Only my own work, or Apache-2.0-compatible code with its source named
- [ ] No vendor manuals, DLLs, installers, sample projects, licence keys or customer data
- [ ] Templates (if any) are empty projects I saved myself, with vendor preset texts and local paths removed; tool version stated
- [ ] No videos or files over 2 MB (`python scripts/check_large_files.py`)
- [ ] No tool that downloads, goes online or writes to a running PLC
- [ ] `py -3 -m pytest tests backends -q` passes
- [ ] README and ROADMAP updated if support changed (translations optional)
